standard.coverage: All employers (COMPS Order); Colorado's constitution sets the floor and the state may not go below it.
standard.note: Colo. Const. art. XVIII sec. 15 annual CPI adjustment, published each year in the COMPS Order.

tipped.note: Colorado's tip credit is fixed at $3.02/hr by the constitution -- like Arizona's, a flat dollar figure. Local ordinances (Denver, Boulder, Boulder County) inherit the same $3.02 credit against their HIGHER local rate; Edgewater is the one Colorado jurisdiction with a larger local tip offset.

knownGaps: Denver, Boulder, unincorporated Boulder County and Edgewater set higher local rates -- see local/CO-local-2026.json.
